div.h2: Too many good tabs. Not enough map.
div.p: FACODI started from a very ordinary study habit: finding brilliant public lessons, videos and documents across the web, then losing the thread between them.
FACODI organises those finds around courses, curricular references and learning paths, so the useful stuff feels less like a tab graveyard and more like a campus.

aside.p: The point is not to replace universities or invent equivalence. It is to make open learning easier to navigate, discuss and improve.
